name: Context Link
description: Connect Claude to your Context Link knowledge base and retrieve just the right context from your connected sources: Notion, Google Drive and any websites. Context Link also has a memory layer where you can save conversation insights, documents and anything else you want to persist directly from an AI interaction
longDescription:
Ships **4 skills** and **3 commands**.

- **Skills** (4): `ask-question` (Ask a question against the user's Context Link and receive a concise, cited answer drawn from their connected…), `get-context` (Retrieve internal knowledge via Context Link when the user references company knowledge or says "get context", "use context…), `save-memory` (Save conversation content or specified text to Context Link for later retrieval), `update-memory` (Retrieve saved content from Context Link, update it with current context, and save it back)
- **Commands** (3): `get-context` (Retrieve knowledge from Context Link), `save-memory` (Save content to Context Link), `update-memory` (Update existing content on Context Link)

Installs with `claude plugin install context-link@claude-community` from `Context-Link/context-link-plugin`.
